newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac credit driven by two factors.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac credit driven by two factors.

text.p: The Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp said Tuesday that advances in its loss mitigation and the disposition of real estate it owns have led to improvements in its credit results.
In this year's third quarter, the company's total real-estate-owned balances were $805 million versus $759 million for the same period in 1995.
Its expenses in the third quarter related to real estate owned stood at $70 million compared with $73 million from the same period in the previous year.
Its loan loss provision for the third quarter was $80 million versus $65 million for the 1995 third quarter.
Meanwhile, its credit-related expenses were $150 million compared with $138 million in the 1995 third quarter.
